title: Dimension of Disaster: Shield of Arrav
start: Speak to Orlando Smith in the New Varrock museum.
prereq_quests: Dimension of Disaster: Coin of the Realm

kills.t: Jonny the beard (if joining the Black Arm Gang)

rewards.l: Thieving XP lamp (Dimension of Disaster: Shield of Arrav)

rewards.t: Always: Access to the Black Arm Gang/Phoenix Gang stash
Always: A mithril grapple and a mithril crossbow

steps.t: Talk to Orlando Smith in the New Varrock Museum. [Chat: Accept › 3 Farewell.]
Speak to Charlie the Tramp [Chat: 1 Can you help me find the Black Arm Gang hideout? › 1 Give him a couple Zemomarks]
p: The battle with Jonny the Beard.

steps.t: Speak to Katrine in the Black Arm Gang Hideout. [Chat: 1 I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang. › 1 I'd rather not reveal my sources. › 2 I want to join your gang. › 4 Farewell.]
Talk to Jonny the Beard in the Blue Moon Inn.
Talk again and defeat Jonny the Beard.

sub.t: If he disappears when you start fighting him, be sure to have auto retaliate on. You can reset the fight by walking upstairs and talking to him again.

steps.t: Take the black arm to Katrine [Chat: 1 I've got your arm. › 1 I want to join the Black Arm Gang. › 4 Farewell.]
Talk to Moira in the back room until you get the documents.
Talk to Baraek in New Varrock square. [Chat: 1 Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang? › 1 Sure have 2 zemomarks. › 4 Farewell.]
Talk to Straven near the south-eastern wall of New Varrock. [Chat: 1 I know who you are! › 2 I want to join your gang. › 1 What do I have to do to join the Phoenix gang?]
Talk to Lowe in his archery emporium.
Go upstairs and take the moving egg by walking around the normal eggs.
Talk to Straven. [Chat: 1 I've got your phoenix eggling. › 3 Clap at the egg. › 1 I want to join the Phoenix Gang.]
Join Phoenix Gang. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Open the door to Molly's room using the pass phrase.
Talk to Molly in the next room until you get the documents.
Head to the West New Varrock Bank.
Talk to Skeleton Clerk. [Chat: 1 I'm here for the Shield of Arrav. › 3 Goodbye.]
p: Retrieving half of the Shield of Arrav from a skeleton clerk.

steps.t: Head to the East New Varrock Bank and go upstairs.
Talk to the Skeleton Clerk. [Chat: 1 I'm here for the Shield of Arrav. › 3 Goodbye.]
Use the 2 shield pieces together to make the Shield of Arrav.
Talk to Orlando Smith at the New Varrock Museum.
Quest complete!
